physical_subject: How can upright and horizontal threads make diagonal bands?
relationship: The crossing indicator (column−row) modulo four shifts the visible patches diagonally; physical spacing determines the band angle.
operation: Reveal successive over-two under-two rows, shift one place each row, identify the four-row repeat and change spacing.
substantive_difference: A discrete interlacing repeat produces diagonal bands, not interference alignment or arithmetic diagonals.
